condition: 데이터 출처·버전 또는 학습표본 수가 확인되지 않음
condition_en: Dataset source, version, or training sample size is unavailable

condition: 독성 양성 비율 또는 imbalance 처리방법이 불명확
condition_en: Positive-class prevalence or imbalance handling is unclear
conclusion_en: Do not rely on accuracy or AUROC alone

condition: 학습·시험 세트가 비독립이거나 화합물·염·이성질체·scaffold 중복이 미평가
condition_en: Training/test sets are non-independent or compound, salt, stereoisomer, or scaffold overlap is unassessed
conclusion_en: Limits generalizability of reported validation performance

condition: 전처리·feature selection·target-derived feature 또는 데이터 중복에서 leakage가 확인되거나 의심됨
condition_en: Leakage is confirmed or suspected in preprocessing, feature selection, target-derived features, or data overlap
conclusion: 보고된 성능을 독립 예측성으로 인정하지 않음
conclusion_en: Reported performance cannot be accepted as independent predictivity

condition: Endpoint 정의, reference standard, label 품질, 관찰기간 또는 중증도 기준이 부족
condition_en: Endpoint definition, reference standard, label quality, observation window, or severity criteria are insufficient
conclusion_en: Limits semantic alignment between model output and the toxicity question

name_en: Separation of Missing Labels from True Negatives
condition: Not tested, not reported 또는 missing evidence가 음성 label로 처리됨
condition_en: Not tested, not reported, or missing evidence is treated as a negative label
conclusion: 음성 class 오염과 false reassurance 위험
conclusion_en: Creates negative-class contamination and false-reassurance risk

condition: Sensitivity, specificity, FNR/NPV 또는 PPV, AUPRC, confidence interval이 충분히 보고되지 않음
condition_en: Sensitivity, specificity, FNR/NPV or PPV, AUPRC, or confidence intervals are insufficiently reported
conclusion_en: Limits reliability of negative or positive predictions

condition_en: The positive/negative decision threshold and its rationale are unavailable
conclusion: 예측 class 재현성과 오류비용 평가 제한
conclusion_en: Limits reproducibility of the predicted class and evaluation of error costs

condition: 외부검증 집단이 현재 modality, endpoint, 노출 또는 population을 대표하지 못함
condition_en: The external validation cohort does not represent the current modality, endpoint, exposure, or population
conclusion: 현재 Context of Use로의 일반화 제한
conclusion_en: Limits generalization to the current Context of Use

condition: 동일 dataset과 threshold에서 sensitivity와 FNR 등 성능지표가 서로 맞지 않음
condition_en: Performance metrics such as sensitivity and FNR are inconsistent for the same dataset and threshold
conclusion_en: Suggests possible mixing of denominators, thresholds, or datasets

condition: 표시된 퍼센트가 calibrated probability인지 불명확하거나 calibration이 검증되지 않음
condition_en: The displayed percentage is not clearly a calibrated probability or calibration is unvalidated
conclusion: 실제 독성 발생확률 또는 안전확률로 표현 금지
conclusion_en: Do not present the output as an actual toxicity or safety probability

condition: Code commit, software lock, data hash, drift trigger, change control 또는 재검증 절차가 부족
condition_en: Code commit, software lock, data hash, drift triggers, change control, or revalidation procedures are insufficient
conclusion_en: Limits repeat use and eligibility for R4/R5

condition: 구조·염형·이성질체·서열·제형 또는 입력 feature가 현재 후보를 정확히 표현하는지 미확인
condition_en: The structure, salt form, stereoisomer, sequence, formulation, or input features are not verified as representing the current candidate
conclusion_en: Caps individual Prediction Reliability at Moderate

condition: Nearest-neighbor, leverage, domain density 또는 OOD detector 근거가 없음
condition_en: No nearest-neighbor, leverage, domain-density, or OOD-detector evidence is available
conclusion_en: Limits objectivity of the applicability-domain assessment

condition: 모델 feature 또는 explanation이 독성기전·제품 특성·검증 가능한 NAM endpoint와 연결되지 않음
condition_en: Model features or explanations are not linked to toxicity mechanisms, product characteristics, or testable NAM endpoints
conclusion_en: Limits mechanistic interpretation and follow-up study design
